items.title: Jurisdiction and entity type
items.description: A single UAE free zone licence costs differently than a mainland entity, an offshore holding company, or a UK Ltd — and differently again if you need more than one.

items.title: Ongoing vs one-time work
items.description: Formation is a one-time project. Bookkeeping, VAT filing, and payroll are recurring — quoted as a monthly or quarterly retainer, not a lump sum.

items.title: Complexity of your structure
items.description: A single founder with one entity is a simpler quote than a group with related entities, cross-border transactions, or a restructuring project.

items.title: How much you need handled
items.description: Some clients want formation only. Others want formation, banking, visas, and ongoing compliance under one retainer. The scope changes the number.
